title: nazar's rainbow
description:
a self-assignable chat colours datapack for changing the colour code of your name in text using teams. doubles as a faction pack

(please wait for update)
body:
java 1.21 - 1.21.1, fabric, geyser

this datapack lets players self-assign chat name colours, and doubles as a faction datapack

use '/trigger n_colour_reset' to bring up the text prompt with clickable links.

use '/trigger n_select_(colour)' to manually choose a colour, especially if you're on bedrock.

use '/function nazars_rainbow:guildyes' and '/function nazars_rainbow:guildno' to turn friendlyfire off and on respectively.

use '/function nazars_rainbow:uninstall' to delete the teams and scoreboards.
uncomment a line in colour_prompt to enable those apples again.
